selection: Disjoint deterministic 32-case relevant sample spanning numeric, visual, table, long-document, context/version, identifier, and clean Top-1 roles, plus all 8 negative/ambiguous development cases.
evaluation_protocol: Feed only the verified evidence snippet and exact source/page for relevant cases; feed no regulatory evidence for negative cases. This isolates generation from retrieval.
limitations: Development-only suite selected from already inspected questions; it cannot establish generalization.
Gold-evidence evaluation measures generation, citation, and refusal behavior but not retrieval sufficiency.
Automated outcome labels must remain separate from human-verified answer correctness and claim support.
